summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Go Big Red facility cleaning app. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests passed (100%) covering auth (all 4 roles incl. admin case-insensitive & boss wrong-password 401), buildings/rooms CRUD & status change, memos w/ x-user-id header, room base64 photos, teacher visits (past/>3-day rejection + toggle), tasks (permission, DM task-card, complete, redo permission), conversations DM dedupe & messages with embedded task, contest (teacher/admin 403 on submit, cleaner submit, any-role vote toggle, has_voted/vote_count), settings admin-only + case-insensitive check, numbers (weekday countdown + per-building buckets). Frontend: auth screen renders with all 4 role cards; Boss sign-in with Coach Riley/boss123 lands on Floor Plan and shows all 4 tabs; floor plan renders colored room pins for Memorial Hall (Room 101 green/completed, 104 red/teacher_in, 102 yellow/in_progress, 103/105 gray, Main Hallway yellow, Front Entry green); tapping Room 101 opens the room detail sheet with Status buttons, Photos, Memos input, Teacher-coming-in section, Tasks with Redo action; Numbers page shows '10 weekdays until school starts' + progress bars per building (rooms/hallways/stairs/entryways); Chats list shows All Chatroom + DM (task redo DM); All Chatroom opens with message history. Cleaner sign-in correctly hides Numbers tab (only FloorPlan/Chats/Contest visible). No deprecated packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch), no red screen errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Continue/submit button gets clipped/pushed off-viewport on smaller mobile heights when both name+password inputs are shown; Playwright had to scroll into view to click. On real devices the keyboard may cover it. Consider wrapping the sheet in a ScrollView or reducing top padding.

Pressing Enter in message input on web does not send the message; only the send button icon works. Fine for RN native but a bit inconsistent for web preview. Consider onSubmitEditing / onKeyPress handling.
No testID on the top-right sign-out icon (log-out) on tab screens. Adding testID='signout' would help automated regression testing and role-switching flows.

issues: Some seeded pins (Room 101/102/103) overlap vertically because their y coords are close. Not a bug, just seed data placement.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — likely in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.card). Migrate to boxShadow for RN Web / RN 0.76+ compatibility.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Search codebase for pointerEvents="..." prop and move into style. Non-blocking but should be cleaned.

action_items: (Optional/LOW) Migrate 'shadow*' style props in src/theme.ts to 'boxShadow' to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
(Optional/LOW) Move any pointerEvents JSX prop into style.pointerEvents.
(Optional/LOW) Add testID='signout' to header sign-out icon for testability.
(Optional/LOW) Handle Enter key press on web to send chat messages (onSubmitEditing / onKeyPress).
(Optional/LOW) Make auth sign-in sheet scrollable so the Continue button stays reachable on short devices when the keyboard is open.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~800 line file; consider splitting routes into modules (auth, rooms, tasks, chat, contest) if it grows further.
seed() only runs when users collection is empty — good for idempotency. Fine as-is.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded via clean() helper everywhere.
Frontend uses testID consistently for the role picker, sign-in inputs, and submit — good.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed (Coach Riley, Sam Carter, Ms. Nguyen, Memorial Hall, Science Center, active contest, school_start ~30 days out). A few TEST_-prefixed transient rows (rooms, memos, tasks, contest submissions, users) created during pytest; some intermediate ones cleaned up, others left in place (submissions, tasks) as they don't interfere with UX.
